description: Bins calcium and spikes into the exact 40-ms evaluation grid, normalizes each neuron robustly, and extracts acausal multiscale level, slope, curvature, and candidate-deconvolution features. A Poisson histogram gradient booster is blended with a ridge model; the blend weight is selected by held-out-neuron validation, then both models are refit on all training neurons. Bin predictions are expanded back to 100 Hz, preserving trailing NaNs.

Detrends and scales each neuron independently, then trains a Poisson gradient-boosted regressor on acausal, multiscale fluorescence features. A fixed random subset of training samples provides early stopping; no test labels are used.

Fits gradient-boosted trees to multiscale fluorescence, derivative, local-envelope, and approximate deconvolution features normalized separately for each neuron. Held-out training neurons select tree count and prediction smoothing using 40-ms binned correlation; the selected model is refit using samples from all training neurons.
